mission.display_title: Fit, infer, predict, and check residuals with software
mission.mission_purpose: Today's Mission exists to use appropriate software to fit a linear regression, interpret inference and fit measures, predict with limits, and use residuals to check suitability — without claiming variable-selection LO complete.
mission.tutor_intent: Today I will force the candidate through fit → infer slope → predict with limits → residual check — refuse menu tourism.
mission.educational_intent: Produce an executable software-literacy chain for simple/multiple LM output.
mission.learning_objective: Use appropriate software to fit a linear regression model and interpret output: inference on slope; goodness of fit; prediction with confidence limits; residual checks.
mission.concept_focus: Fit → infer → predict → residual check → refuse tourism.
mission.prior_bridge: Yesterday you earned OLS method warrant (4.1.3). Today executes software literacy.
mission.why_now: 4.1.4 is the software-and-diagnostics LO before selection (4.1.5).
mission.expected_benefit: Study Progress for software LM chain — not full 4.1.5 selection theatre.
success_criteria: Closed-book, outline fit → slope inference → prediction with limits → residual check.
Interpret one software output cue from notes.
Refuse menu tourism without residual check.
task_descriptions: Sketch the four-move chain before CMP.

knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: 4.1.4
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. List in order: (1) fit model in software; (2) what you check for slope inference; (3) what a prediction with confidence limits adds; (4) why inspect residuals.
hints: Use CMP language from today's notes.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Fit → slope inference (estimate/se/test or CI) → prediction with limits → residuals to check suitability/validity.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Skipping the LO hinge or swallowing the next LO.

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 4.1.4
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Refuse: 'I fitted the model so I am done.' Name the missing check that 4.1.4 requires before trust.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Refuse: fit alone is not enough. Use residuals to check suitability/validity (and honour inference/prediction requirements).
